rule: A link that offers a page the same login is refused (backlog #79sqf). scripts/check-destination-activity.mjs fails on any finding not listed here and on any entry that is no longer a finding. Each entry is an unfixed fault found by the check on its first run, to be FIXED and the entry deleted, never a ruling that it is fine. Never add an entry to make a new link pass: fix the link (draw it only when can() asks the destination activity).
